limitations: The native fixture advertised one tool; this proves exact original-thread observation and raw tool naming, not a live fleet's current expected bank.

Embedded or --no-daemon hand-started Codex sessions expose no attachable native catalog endpoint. They report unverified with the managed-hire fixing action; an independent observer runtime is never substituted.

Native systemMessage pane rendering is supported by the installed client contract and covered through the hook subprocess/HTTP/output boundary; this smoke did not load the production worker plugin or contact its service.
